cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.intro: During your navigation on the Guelichweb agency website (guelichweb.online), information may be recorded in "cookie" files installed on your computer, tablet, or mobile phone. This page explains what cookies are, how we use them, and how you can control them.

sections.title: 1. What is a cookie?
sections.content: A cookie is a small harmless text file deposited on your terminal when visiting a site or viewing an advertisement. Their aim is notably to collect information relating to your navigation and to provide you with personalized services and improve your user experience.

sections.title: 2. The cookies we use
sections.content:
A. Strictly technical and functional cookies

These cookies are essential for the proper direct functioning of the site and the fluidity of navigation. They notably allow the use of main functionalities, the maintenance of your preference choices, and the routing of requests. These cookies cannot be deactivated.

B. Analytical and performance cookies

We use audience analysis tools to understand how visitors navigate our site, measure the bounce rate, and identify potential display bugs. The data collected by these trackers is anonymous (it is not attached to your name or your email) and is only used to produce global statistics so that Guelichweb can continuously improve the quality of its interfaces.

sections.title: 3. Improving the User Experience
sections.content: We are committed to minimizing the use of trackers. All data collected via potential cookies is exploited for the sole purpose of improving the customer experience – for example by understanding which offers interest our clients most to show you more relevant content, as well as for the security of our platform.

sections.title: 4. Cookie management and browser opt-out
sections.content:
In accordance with European and international regulations, you have the full freedom to accept or refuse cookies (with the exception of strictly technical cookies).

You can configure your browser settings at any time (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge, etc.) to systematically reject cookies or ask for your permission every time a site attempts to place one.

Note: If you choose to block all cookies, including technical ones, access to certain pages and functions of the web platform may be severely altered or blocked.
